title: Web performance workbench and API
behavioral_concerns: Disabled projects expose no mutation controls; refreshing, navigation, session loss, or event disconnection does not cancel durable work.
Evidence cursor, filter, and page size remain bounded, and raw artifact contents are never returned.
HTML and API routes expose status, result, and bounded evidence metadata with schema-versioned sample-free DTOs.
Hostile target and status text is escaped in HTML and sanitized in public JSON.
The server-rendered no-JavaScript workbench shows authority, lifecycle, targets, qualification, limits and sources, blockers, next action, and evidence paging.
Transport decoding rejects caller-selected authority or execution options for performance operations.
Typed performance failures map to stable safe HTTP responses without leaking internal diagnostics or secrets.

evidence.summary: Status routing, aggregate projection, and template consumption show that operational lifecycle fields are not enriched on the surfaces that display them (qa-v1-block-95f9f726d965e7685184fba7, qa-v1-block-78e13c26eb8ae322452c9951, qa-v1-block-b78a61cde5b699690eb3c5f2).

The evidence compatibility branch emits an ad hoc unversioned map, and the evidence capability is optional relative to status/result queries (qa-v1-block-95f9f726d965e7685184fba7, qa-v1-block-4c2e9e074e2f61478a2c1b5d).

theories.claim: The performance status API and server-rendered workbench omit durable operational lifecycle and cancellation state because they obtain performance data through the aggregate Sprint query rather than the dedicated PerformanceStatus query that enriches those fields.
theories.basis: The API status handler calls Sprint and returns result.Performance (qa-v1-block-95f9f726d965e7685184fba7), while aggregate summaries use performanceSummaryForSprint (qa-v1-block-c1bc237cbe63b9df34c97ed7), which only delegates to performanceStatusProjection (qa-v1-block-78e13c26eb8ae322452c9951). The workbench explicitly renders OperationalLifecycle and CancellationState from that aggregate result (qa-v1-block-b78a61cde5b699690eb3c5f2).
theories.verification_surface: GET performance status API and the no-JavaScript performance workbench during an active or cancellation-requested durable run.
theories.confirmation_condition: For a performance state with an operation run ID and an available durable run snapshot, the API and HTML still render empty/default operational lifecycle or cancellation state.
theories.refutation_condition: The aggregate Sprint query demonstrably enriches Performance with the durable run snapshot before either surface receives it.
theories.inconclusive_condition: The omitted Sprint query implementation contains an unshown enrichment step or the displayed fields are populated by another documented source.
theories.safe_evidence_strategy: Use a product-owned contract check or bounded static inspection to compare the aggregate Sprint projection with PerformanceStatus for a fixture carrying a durable run lifecycle and cancellation state; inspect metadata only.

theories.claim: The performance evidence endpoint has a compatibility path that returns an unversioned ad hoc artifact payload instead of the schema-versioned PerformanceEvidenceResult DTO.
theories.basis: The evidence handler falls back to a map containing attempt_id, artifacts, and returned_count when WebPerformanceEvidenceQueries is unavailable, with no schema_version, records, or next_cursor fields (qa-v1-block-95f9f726d965e7685184fba7). The query capabilities are intentionally split so an implementation may satisfy WebPerformanceQueries without satisfying WebPerformanceEvidenceQueries (qa-v1-block-4c2e9e074e2f61478a2c1b5d). The documented endpoint promises bounded evidence references (qa-v1-block-a11b800e9abfe97c390d8c4b).
theories.verification_surface: GET performance evidence API with a query adapter implementing WebPerformanceQueries but not WebPerformanceEvidenceQueries.
theories.confirmation_condition: The endpoint responds successfully with the fallback artifacts object and lacks the versioned evidence DTO fields.
theories.refutation_condition: All supported query implementations are required to implement WebPerformanceEvidenceQueries, making the fallback unreachable, or the fallback is wrapped into the same documented versioned DTO before serialization.
theories.inconclusive_condition: An omitted compatibility contract explicitly defines the fallback payload as a separately versioned supported schema.
theories.safe_evidence_strategy: Use a bounded adapter-level request with metadata-only artifact references and inspect only response field names and status.
